About Us:

XS Espresso is a place to get a morning coffee fix, breakfast, lunch and dinner as well as dessert to satisfy all customer cravings. It is a cafe/restaurant with high quality dishes, an extensive an menu and highly trained staff with a large customer base.

The Role:

XS Espresso is seeking a Chef to oversee the efficient operation of the kitchen and assist in the preparation, cooking and presentation of high-quality meals. The Chef will ensure that all food is prepared in accordance with XS Espresso's standards while maintaining consistency, quality and compliance with food safety requirements.

The Chef will be responsible for planning and preparing menu items, assisting with seasonal menu development and specials, selecting quality ingredients, supervising food preparation and ensuring the efficient operation of the kitchen. All work will be conducted in a fully functioning, clean and organised kitchen.

Applicants must be able to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment and possess excellent knowledge of food preparation techniques, ingredients, food safety requirements and kitchen operations. Strong communication, organisational and time management skills are essential, together with the ability to work collaboratively with management and kitchen staff to deliver a high standard of food and customer satisfaction.

Duties:

•	Prepare, cook and present menu items in accordance with XS Espresso's recipes, quality standards and customer requirements.
•	Assist in planning menus and developing seasonal specials, taking into account customer demand, ingredient availability and current food trends.
•	Select, inspect and prepare quality ingredients to ensure consistency and high standards of food quality.
•	Supervise and coordinate kitchen operations to ensure the timely preparation and service of meals.
•	Monitor food preparation and presentation to maintain quality, portion control and consistency.
•	Estimate food requirements, place stock orders, monitor inventory levels and conduct regular stocktakes to minimise waste and ensure adequate supplies.
•	Ensure all food handling, storage and preparation complies with food safety legislation, hygiene standards and workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Maintain a clean, safe and organised kitchen, ensuring all equipment is properly cleaned, maintained and used safely.
•	Assist in training, supervising and supporting kitchen staff to ensure efficient kitchen operations and compliance with company standards.
•	Work efficiently during busy service periods, including weekends, public holidays and large functions, while maintaining a high standard of food quality.
•	Liaise with management regarding menu planning, stock requirements, customer feedback and operational improvements.
•	Assist in controlling food costs and minimising wastage while maintaining the quality and presentation of all dishes.
•	Ensure all kitchen operations comply with company policies, procedures and relevant legislative requirements.
•	Perform other duties reasonably required to ensure the efficient operation of the kitchen.


Qualifications and Requirements

•	A relevant Certificate IV, Diploma or higher qualification in Commercial Cookery or a related field is required. In lieu of a formal qualification, at least three (3) years of relevant full-time work experience as a Chef in a similar establishment will be accepted.
•	A minimum of three (3) years' experience working as a Chef in a busy café, restaurant or similar hospitality environment.
•	Demonstrated experience in planning menus and developing new dishes and seasonal menu items.
•	Ability to estimate food and labour costs, order supplies and maintain appropriate stock levels.
•	Strong knowledge of food preparation, cooking techniques, presentation and quality control.
•	Proven ability to supervise, train and mentor kitchen staff and contribute to the efficient operation of the kitchen.
•	Sound knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation and workplace health and safety requirements, with the ability to ensure compliance at all times.


Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply

Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $78,000.00 – $80,000.00 per year

For nearly 25 years, APD Global has set the benchmark in delivering advanced, comprehensive, and specialised engineering solutions.

We have around 800 employees including our alliance contracting partners, across 15 strategically located offices in Australia (Perth, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Darwin), New Zealand and Malaysia. We specialise in seamless integration across the Power Systems, Telecommunications, and Renewable Energy industries. Our expertise spans Power Systems Studies, Transmission Lines, Substations, Telecommunications, Protection, Control & Automation, Renewable Energy Connections, Mining, and Engineering, Protection Panel Design and Installation, 3D Design and Manufacturing as well as Construction/Management (EPC/M) services.

We have outstanding opportunity for a highly experienced and skilled ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGIST to join our team across all states in Australia. We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team. Position available in Vic, Qld, WA, 
and NSW.

The Role
A space-based Engineering Technologist at a power company primarily uses satellite technology to enhance the power grid. This role requires the successful candidate to manage projects from start to finish, ensuring the effective and cohesive operation of both space and ground systems to meet the company's operational and strategic goals.

Key duties involve: Designing and implementing satellite communication systems, Utilising satellite data for grid analysis, and Integrating space-based technology into existing ground infrastructure.

Core duties
System design and architecture: Design and define the architecture for satellite-based communication, monitoring, or sensing systems to be used by the power company. This includes analyzing performance and technical specifications.
Power and communication integration: Ensure that satellite power systems and communication links are compatible with the power company's ground infrastructure and can transmit data and commands reliably.
Mission and project management: Oversee the entire lifecycle of a project, including research, design, development, testing, and deployment of space-based assets, ensuring they meet the company's objectives.
Stakeholder management: Coordinate with internal teams (e.g., grid operations, IT, finance) and external partners (e.g., satellite operators, vendors) to ensure seamless integration and collaboration.
Data analysis: Work with and analyze data from satellites to support power grid management, such as monitoring assets, predicting demand, or assessing grid health and stability.
Technical oversight: Ensure that all subsystems of a space-based system function correctly together, addressing any integration issues or performance bottlenecks that arise.
Testing and validation: Develop and execute test plans for new systems and validate that they meet performance and safety requirements before and during deployment.
Risk and compliance management: Identify and manage risks associated with using space-based technology and ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards.

Example scenario:
A power company might employ a space-based systems engineer to create a system for real-time monitoring of remote substations. The engineer would design a system using a constellation of small satellites to collect data.

Their duties would include:
Defining the requirements for the satellite communication system, including data rates and latency.
Designing the satellite payload and its integration with the company's ground control software.
Ensuring the system's power budget is adequate for its mission lifespan.
Testing the system on the ground to verify its performance before launch.
Collaborating with the satellite operator to ensure smooth data delivery once the system is operational

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

The Client 

Our client is a registered pharmacy outlet chain located in Ashmore, Queensland. 

 

The Role 

They are seeking a full-time registered Retail Pharmacist to join their team in Ashmore, Queensland. 

This is for a full-time position at an annual salary between $77,000 and $97,000 plus superannuation. 

 

 

The Responsibilities 

Deliver high-quality pharmacy services, including dispensing prescription medicines, providing patient counselling, offering health information, and primary health care. 

Provide patient-centred care by collaborating with GPs, allied health professionals, healthcare providers, and the community. 

Dispense prescriptions in compliance with Pharmacy Board of Australia and National Health Act regulations. Responsibilities include prescription medicines counselling, supplying Pharmacist Only Medicines, and supervising the supply of Pharmacy Medicines, unscheduled medicines, and health products. 

Utilise dispensary assistants for routine dispensing tasks when available. 

Provide pharmacy advice on medication use and offer comprehensive services, including home medicine reviews, dose administration aids, opioid substitution therapy, disease management, medication adherence support, and health promotion. 

Maintain a high level of customer service, ensuring all tasks are carried out competently and promptly. 

Ensure patient safety and optimal medication use during dispensing. Document clinical interventions using GuildCare software and intervene as needed to prevent medication errors. 

Offer staged supply services based on requests from prescribers or patients/carers in accordance with established guidelines. 

Complete all dispensing activities in line with HIC requirements and prepare PBS and other Medicare claims as necessary. 

Report any errors, discrepancies, or ethical breaches that arise in the pharmacy. 

Assist in managing dispensary stock by checking expiration dates, rotating inventory, and monitoring storage conditions such as fridge temperatures. 

Oversee the ordering and receipt of pharmacy stock, following internal protocols. 

Continuously update professional knowledge regarding medications, including their uses, dosages, side effects, and complementary products and services. 

Stay updated on legislation to ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory obligations, including: 

Pharmacy Practice Act 2004 

Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S) regulations 

Quality Care Pharmacy Program (QCPP) standards 

Maintain prescription records and accurately track the dispensing of controlled substances. 

Properly store and preserve medications prone to deterioration, such as vaccines and serums. 

Supervise and coordinate the activities of Pharmacy Technicians, interns, and Pharmacy Sales Assistants. 

Supply non-prescription medicines and offer diagnostic and therapeutic aids. 

 

The requirements 

Successful completion of a Bachelor of Pharmacy 

A current general registration with AHPRA 

At least 12 months of experience in fulfilling similar responsibility in a retail pharmacy setting. 

Attention to detail and precision in record keeping. 

Demonstrated experience working in fast paced environment. 

Ability to work autonomously and in a face-paced, pressured environment. 

Ability to contribute ideas, demonstrate initiative and manage change. 

Able to operate effectively in a team, contributing positively to team operations and working relationships. 

Ability to plan and organise self and others to ensure the timely completion of tasks and achievement of targets. 

At least 12 months of proficiency in pharmacy dispensing software and point-of-sale (POS) systems. 

At least 12 months of experience in providing customer service and pharmaceutical counselling.

Position Description – Marketing Specialist (ANZSCO 225113) 

Our client is a well-established Australian wholesaler specialising in B2B imports and exports, they supply premium wellness, health, and lifestyle products, specialising in reliable, bulk distribution for Australian and overseas businesses across all major markets around the globe.  

They are now seeking an experienced Marketing Specialist to join their team in Archerfield in QLD. 

 

The Role  

This is a full-time role with an annual salary of $80,000 - $100,000 plus superannuation, and involves the following tasks: 

Research wellness, health and lifestyle market conditions, customer needs, competitor activity, and purchasing trends to identify opportunities for new and existing products. 

Analyse sales, customer, product and campaign data to assess market performance and inform marketing decisions. 

Develop and implement marketing plans for wellness, health and lifestyle products supplied to pharmacies, retailers, hospitals, wellness practitioners and other authorised business customers. 

Advise on pricing strategies and product mix, assessing the impact of pricing decisions on sales performance and profitability.  

Define target customer segments and develop appropriate product positioning, value propositions and marketing messages for each segment. 

Plan and coordinate product launches, portfolio initiatives, and business-to-business campaigns across digital, email, trade and industry channels. 

Prepare campaign briefs and coordinate the production of product guidelines, presentations, email communications, and digital content. 

Collaborate with sales, procurement and supply-chain teams to align marketing activities with customer demand, product availability and commercial priorities. 

Liaise with external suppliers, agencies and vendors to support marketing production and campaign delivery.  

Develop and/or manage website and email content ensuring trade-only materials are restricted to appropriate business and wholesale audiences where required. 

Create, schedule and publish content across the company website and social media platforms, and recommend updates to improve search engine optimisation (SEO) and digital performance.  

Monitor campaign outcomes using agreed measures such as engagement, enquiries, customer acquisition, product uptake, and return on marketing expenditure. 

Prepare reports and recommendations for management on market opportunities, campaign performance, portfolio development and future marketing investment. 

 

Required experience: 

A Bachelor’s degree in Business or Marketing 

At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience in the B2B sector 

At least 5  years’ experience in brand management and marketing 

At least 5 years of experience in digital and traditional marketing in a commercial role 

At least 5 years of experience social and digital marketing 

At least 5 years of proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Google Analytics, Facebook Ads Manager, and Google Ads 

At least 5 years of SEO experience in content optimization 

At least 5 years of experience in UX/UI digital marketing calibration  

Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking. 

Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team to achieve marketing objectives 

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

•	Develop a lifelong love of learning through child-led enquiries, connections to local primary school and positive experiences within the community.
•	Plan and deliver engaging learning experiences that support children's cognitive, social, emotional, physical and language development.
•	Evaluate educational programs allowing for the unique and individual interests and strengths of each child.
•	Observe, assess and document each children's learning and developmental progress.
•	Build strong partnerships with families to share insights and gain an understanding of each child's unique background.
•	Create a safe, inclusive and stimulating learning environment that promotes children's wellbeing and participation.
•	Support children's individual learning needs and encourage their independence and confidence.
•	Ensure compliance with the National Quality Framework (NQF), National Quality Standards (NQS), Child Safe Standards, and relevant regulations.
•	Participate in team meetings, professional development, and continuous quality improvement initiatives.
•	Provide guidance and support to educators and contribute to a collaborative team culture.
•	Motivate, mentor and lead a team of educators within the learning environment.



Skills and Experience
•	Bachelor Degree or higher qualification in Early Childhood Education or a related field recognised for Early Childhood Teaching in Australia.
•	Minimum one year of relevant post-qualification experience as an Early Childhood Teacher (preferred).
•	Sound knowledge of the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF), National Quality Standards (NQS), and relevant legislation.
•	Strong understanding of child development and early childhood education principles.
•	Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
•	Comply with the centres policies and procedures along with licensing, legislation & regulations.
•	Demonstrated ability to lead a kindergarten program and mentor educators.
•	Experience using digital platforms for observations, assessments and family communications.
•	Experience in creating and implementing engaging educational programs is essential.
•	Ability to plan and implement developmentally appropriate educational programs.
•	Strong observation, assessment and documentation skills.
•	Current Working with Children Check.
•	Current First Aid, CPR, Asthma and Anaphylaxis Management Certificates (or ability to obtain).


How to apply:

Applications open on 20 July 2026 and close on 19 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

result.description:
Practice medicine the way it should be with time, trust, and true clinical support.

    Longer, more meaningful consultations with your patients
    A genuinely collaborative, multidisciplinary clinical team
    Flexible arrangements designed around your life, not the other way around
    A community-based model focused on quality, continuity and prevention

About Holstep Health

As one of Victoria's largest not-for-profit community health organisations, Holstep Health supports individuals, families, and communities with compassionate wrap-around care and services to support physical, mental, social, financial, and legal wellbeing.

Our practices are designed to give clinicians the environment they need to deliver thoughtful, high-quality medicine. That means strong clinical governance, integrated services, and a team-based approach where responsibility and support is shared.

This is care that is connected, considered, and built around people.

The Opportunity

We're seeking General Practitioners to join our fully accredited practices, with full-time or part-time options available (contractor or salaried). You'll step into an established, well-supported environment where the focus is on clinical quality, continuity of care, and meaningful patient relationships, not volume.

What your day will look like

    Delivering comprehensive, patient-centred care across all life stages
    Managing a balanced mix of acute, chronic and preventative care
    Working closely with nurses, consultants and co-located services
    Supporting patients and families to make informed, confident decisions
    Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and clinical excellence
    Maintaining strong continuity of care through clear communication and handover

What you'll bring

    Registration with the Medical Practitioners Board of Victoria
    A thoughtful, patient-centred approach to general practice
    Confidence working within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment
    A genuine interest in preventative care and long-term health outcomes

What you'll gain

    Flexibility to shape your working week (full-time or part-time)
    Contractor or salaried options to suit your preference
    Access to salary packaging and additional leave
    A supportive, values-led organisation that invests in your development

How to Apply

To apply for this job go to: https://holstephealth.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies & enter ref code: 6889594.

If you're looking for a practice where clinical care is given the time, respect and support it deserves this is where you'll find it.

Apply now and rediscover what good medicine feels like.
 	Holstep Health supports healthcare workforce vaccination to manage infectious disease in the workplace to protect our clients and community.

Holstep Health is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to ensuring a safe environment for everyone and meets the current Child Safe standards.

All applicants must have the right to work in Australia. We warmly encourage people from diverse backgrounds and abilities to apply.
